  \]
  Here, the summation term involves products of pairs \((2k)(2k + 1)\) from \( k = 1 \) to \( 19 \), plus the initial term 1.

We compute the difference \( A - B \):

\[
A - B = \left[ \sum_{k=1}^{19} (2k - 1)(2k) + 39 \right] - \left[ 1 + \sum_{k=1}^{19} (2k)(2k + 1) \right]
\]
